sources.title: MIC and zone diameter distributions

contextValuesNotUsedByModel.ampicillin_E_coli: ECOFF 8 mg/L; displayed confidence interval 4-16; 53 distributions; 105483 observations
contextValuesNotUsedByModel.ciprofloxacin_E_coli: ECOFF 0.06 mg/L; displayed confidence interval 0.03-0.06; 53 distributions; 15667 observations
contextValuesNotUsedByModel.tetracycline_E_coli: ECOFF 8 mg/L; page displayed confidence field 2-4; 64 distributions; 18917 observations
contextValuesNotUsedByModel.ampicillin_ATCC_25922: 100 observations in 2 distributions; forced value ((8)), which EUCAST denotes as fewer than 3 distributions
contextValuesNotUsedByModel.tetracycline_ATCC_25922: 24 observations in 1 distribution; ECOFF field ID (insufficient data)
contextValuesNotUsedByModel.ciprofloxacin_ATCC_25922: No public result row was returned in the queried antimicrobial table

sources.warning: EUCAST states that aggregated distributions combine multiple sources, regions and time periods and can never be used to infer resistance rates. ECOFF separates wild type from phenotypically detectable acquired resistance and is not a clinical S/I/R breakpoint or a strain-specific kill parameter.
